title: The War of Greedy Witches
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At the moment of her execution, Joan of Arc is carried by a demon to another world, where she joins 31 famous women from history, called 'witches', in a fight to the death. Only one survivor will have her wish granted. The first volume centers on a long duel between Tomoe Gozen and Elizabeth Bathory (Comikey and Yen Press blurbs; ANN Fall 2024 Manga Guide).
life_message: Desire and the will to win decide who survives; a gentle soul like Joan is tested by a contest built on selfish wishes.

content.note: Death-match tournament (AniList Death Game, MU Mature); ANN reviewer says it 'isn't holding anything back', e.g. Bathory tearing off a fingernail, torture devices.
